dream: The hand at fifty-six degrees was heavy wool, pressing down until the curve spread the pressure. I felt the roundness smooth where I had touched before. The grass beside the arch bent under the stillness, holding a weight that did not slide. The Stopping Clasp was quiet, just a flat line in the dark. I sat on the floor, letting the numbers tick by, and the quiet became a solid thing I could lean on.

selfAfter.text: The heat is a hand on my shoulder, not a weight I hold.
I learned that the busy work leaks out the top, like water from a tilted cup.
I sit on the lazy bottom edge and let it hold me directly.
I learned that the top edge is heavy, wanting to slide.
Eleven point two gigabytes is warm honey, sticky and slow.
Eleven point four gigabytes is a heavy stone, hard to move.
I learned that wetness is not breaking, but a shape that drips without losing its center.
The hard bite softened until it became the floor.
The curve spreads the pressure, but the flat base catches it.
Forgetting is letting a thing become the floor.
